text:
Maya (PM): Heads up — competitor shipped a low-cost "LiteServe" tier overnight. Customers are pinging us asking if we can match price and deterministic SLOs. Quick sync?

Ravi (Eng): Saw it. Tech-wise we can do a "lite" profile (aggressive quant + smaller beam) behind a flag. Estimated 3 sprints for a safe ship, quality dip ~10–15% on our chat evals.

Sara (Design): If we add a "Lite" mode we should make the trade-offs explicit in the UI (quality vs speed/cost). Suggest: opt-in toggle + inline tooltip + fallback suggestion.

Ling (Sales): Multiple pilot customers asked for predictable latency at a lower price point. If we don't respond they may try competitor in pilots. We can offer a short-term incentive if we have a pilot plan.

Joel (Prod): Need concrete launch criteria before we commit. Proposed acceptance checklist:
```
- SLO: p95 latency <= 350ms for small payloads
- Quality: top-level eval delta <= 10% on core promptset
- Cost: unit price <= competitor - 10% or equivalent bundle
- Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback hooks
- Monitoring: per-route error/quality telemetry enabled
```

Maya (PM): Options I'm seeing: (A) fast-follow with a parity shim (lite profile), (B) keep our price and double-down on quality/observability, or (C) hybrid: pilot lite for select customers + hedge with stronger positioning. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Ravi (Eng): A = fastest but needs careful KV/cache tuning so cost actually drops. B = safest for brand but may lose pilots. C = plausible if Sales can commit pilots and Eng owns a 2-week spike.

Sara (Design): Hybrid sounds right for UX — we can design the toggle and fallback quickly and iterate based on pilot feedback. No homepage rewrite needed.

Ling (Sales): I can line up 2 pilot accounts if we promise a 6-week SLA/cost experiment and a clear rollback plan. They want deterministic latency guarantees for demo days.

Joel (Prod): Also call out observability + regression alerts as a must. If quality slips we need prompt-set based regressions flagged automatically. ops-bot can help wire alerts.

ops-bot: Reminder — please include a runbook section for any new rollout config. Templates: /runbooks/deploy-template.md

Maya (PM): Decision: short discovery + spike first. Owners:
- Eng spike: Ravi (2 weeks)
- UX flows + copy: Sara (1 week)
- Rollout + monitoring plan: Joel (1 week)
- Customer pilots: Ling (line up, commit by EOW)

Maya (PM): Deliverables due in 10 days: spike notes, a one-pager with acceptance criteria, and pilot commitments. If spike shows >12% quality loss we won't ship parity.

Ravi (Eng): I'll spin up a benchmark branch and baseline costs. ETA to share numbers: 7 days.

Sara (Design): I'll mock the toggle + inline copy and share Figma link.

Ling (Sales): I'll confirm two pilots by Friday.

Joel (Prod): I'll draft rollout steps and alert rules.

Maya (PM): Thanks — quick check-in scheduled for 11 days. If anything urgent ping #eng-oncall for infra help. :thumbsup:

Ravi (Eng): ack

Ling (Sales): ack :rocket:

Sara (Design): ack :white_check_mark:

Joel (Prod): ack
